summary: Backend-only validation of Import IA bug fix. All 8 pytest tests passed (100%). The chained flow POST /api/admin/import/bulk-create + POST /api/admin/import/session both return HTTP 200. The session endpoint now returns a clean JSON dict with id as string (no ObjectId), confirming the fix. Products are correctly created and retrievable via GET /api/products with all fields (description, description_en, description_es, cover_image). Auth guards on all 3 endpoints verified (401/403 without token). Sessions listing returns clean id strings. All test products deleted afterwards.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is large (~879 lines) — consider splitting into modules (auth, admin, products, import) for maintainability.

import_bulk_create does not wrap inserts in a try/except; a partial failure mid-loop would return no info about how many actually succeeded. Consider using insert_many or reporting created + failed counts.
No pagination on GET /api/admin/import/sessions (limit 50 fixed) — acceptable for now.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 TEST_ products (Alpha, Beta, Chained) and deleted them all successfully via DELETE /api/admin/products/{id}. Import sessions rows remain in DB (no delete endpoint) — 2 test rows added.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fixed and verified. Reusable pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_import_ia.py covers auth, bulk-create, session (chained), sessions list, and cleanup.
rca of the issue: POST /api/admin/import/session previously returned the mutated doc from motor's insert_one(doc), which contained the injected _id (ObjectId) — not JSON-serializable by FastAPI's default encoder -> 500 error. Frontend importSelected() chains bulk-create then session; the 500 on session was interpreted as 'Échec de l'import' even though products had already been created. Fix: return {id: str(inserted_id), date, **body.model_dump()} — plain dict with string id. Verified via test_save_import_session_returns_clean_json and test_chained_bulk_then_session.
